name: Sincerely Yours
source:
Sincerely Yours is a story about how two people, Hanano Yumeha and Terasaka Daiki learned how to depend on each other after they both shared a short moment in their long life. A moment they both treasured, a moment worth a lifetime. 

Made for TyranoBuilder Summer Jam 2015.

[Edited from [url=https://shuyafay.itch.io/sincerely-yours]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Sincerely Yours》讲述了Hanano Yumeha与Terasaka Daiki的故事：两人在漫长的人生中共度了一段短暂时光，也由此学会了彼此依靠。那段时光是两人共同珍藏的回忆，短暂一瞬，却值得铭记一生。

本作为TyranoBuilder Summer Jam 2015游戏创作活动制作。

[编译自[url=https://shuyafay.itch.io/sincerely-yours]Itch.io[/url]]
